description: List, add or remove the scripts and actions Photoshop runs when an event happens, and turn them on or off (File > Scripts > Script Events Manager)

event.description: add: the event, as a four-character code or event id, e.g. "Opn " (Open Document), "save", "Mk  " (New Document)

eventClass.description: add: the class the event applies to, e.g. "Dcmn" to fire Make only for documents

index.description: remove: the notifier's index from list

scriptFile.description: add: absolute path of the .jsx or .js script to run

name: manage_script_events
title: Manage Script Events
